sentences.text: The living room stayed below 18.0 °C, reaching 16.9 °C at 05:00, and the office was also cool, hitting 17.5 °C at 05:20.
Because both rooms stayed below 18.0 °C, please remember that the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Since the temperatures were low in both rooms, perhaps it would be a good idea to check the heating system.
